backupRestore.title: Backup & restore categories
backupRestore.intro:
Export: pack the category of every classified photo plus your custom category definitions into a JSON file under the public Downloads folder.
Restore: pick a backup from Downloads and match local photos by file name + size + capture time; matched ones get their category restored, the rest are untouched.
backupRestore.empty: No backup files in the Downloads folder yet
backupRestore.footTip: Restoring across phones? Copy imagepilot-backup-*.json from Downloads to the same folder on the new device, then come back to this page to restore.
backupRestore.deleteConfirm:
Delete {{name}}?
This cannot be undone, but local gallery categories are not affected.
backupRestore.restoreConfirm: Match the category index in {{name}} against the local gallery and restore matches (only matched photos are overwritten, the rest stay put). Continue?
